items.title: Last checked opening hours
items.body:
### Describe the idea

It's no secret that OSM has some pretty old data at times, eg [these](https://www.openstreetmap.org/node/2379058434/history#map=19/51.535281/9.935645) opening hours are 12 years old. Most aren't that extreme, but still aren't good enough to blindly trust. I always check the first party website when looking for opening hours.

### Expected behaviour

It would nice if OsmAnd could use `check_date:opening_hours` to inform users when opening hours where last checked. This tag has seen a dramatic increase in [usage](https://taginfo.openstreetmap.org/keys/check_date:opening_hours#overview) since StreetComplete started asking users to confirm opening hours. This could be used to add a note "These hours where last checked x weeks ago,"

There is also `opening_hours:url` which has a lot less [usage](https://taginfo.openstreetmap.org/keys/opening_hours:url), but if it was more popular the two could be combined to "These hours where last checked x weeks ago, for the most up to date see (link)."

### Alternatives you've considered

I have to check the first party website 100% of the time, I never know if I can trust OSM data. If I know OSM is relatively fresh, I can trust it.

### Context

Here is Googles UI. They explicitly say it was confirmed by the business, and even though OSM is getting more businesses self editing than ever before, that is a, not known, and b, not more relevant than a OSM mapper.


![Image](https://github.com/user-attachments/assets/966dc55f-0c1f-4a89-97a7-8f8267f5bfe2)

items.title: opening_hours:covid19=
items.body:
A team in France have put together a [tagging scheme](https://wiki.openstreetmap.org/wiki/Key%3Aopening_hours%3Acovid19) for restricted opening hours due to the pandemic. They have also [launched a map](https://www.caresteouvert.fr/) to display these details. It currently only covers France, but according to their GitHub, it will be expanding worldwide.

The tag has already been [used 12000](https://taginfo.openstreetmap.org/search?q=opening_hours%3Acovid19) times, mostly in France.

Is this something OsmAnd wants to support?

items.title: opening times is 24/7 when evaluating "months-range Off" opening_hours definitions
items.body:
### Description
Take a POI with a opening_hours definition only for the months it is closed to the public, it might be the case for restaurants or tourism POIs closed during the off season but with uncertain opening times. Osmand will than make the assumption that the POI is open 24/7 during the high season, which is often not the case.

### How to reproduce?
Tap on a POI with opening_hours="Oct-May off". Osmand will correctly display 24/7 "Off" during Oct-May but will also display "24/7 Open" during Jun-Sep. It should just say nothing about the opening times during Jun-Sep as it is not explicitly defined in the tag.

### Your Environment
OsmAnd Version: 3.9.10
Android/iOS version: 10
Device model: RMX2170

**Maps used** offline

# 🚀 feature request

### Description

Filter found POI by opening hours *and* distance (travel time). Show as open only those one can reach before they close. Also show those that are nearby and will be open soon even if they are not open yet.

<!-- ✍️ A clear and concise description of the feature... -->

### Describe the solution you'd like

#### Opening time

Smart handling of soon-to-be open POIs can help users save time and travel. For example, there are two POIs, one is already open but is 1 km away (~10 m walk), the other is 500 m away in the opposite direction and will be open in 5 minutes. It is definitely more convenient to take a walk to the latter, because it's closer and it will be open when one gets there.

#### Closing time

To tell if one manages to reach a POI before it closes it is necessary to know the distance and speed. Precise distance calculation require finding route to each POI which is infeasible. IMHO straight line distance multiplied by square root of two as a worst case scenario is a good approximation. Regarding the speed

Choosing speed isn't difficult as such but needs a good UI. Some heuristics can be applied based on the distance, e.g. for POIs within 30 min walk (2-3 km) walking speed of 4-6 km/h can be applied. For POIs in range of 5-6 km (30 min by bike) 10-15 km/h can be set. Farther ones can get 20-30 km/h, an average speed of car/public transport travel. Whether to apply such heuristics should be user's choice.

#### General considerations

In case of this solution as well as the current one, where POIs can either be displayed or hidden, depending on their opening hours and the current time, I think closed POIs should not be completely hidden but rather marked as closed e.g. with a reduced opacity of icons. This gives users more information and may allow them to use additional knowledge to find a POI they need. This may be especially useful in case of soon-to-be open POIs.

<!-- ✍️ If you have a solution in mind, please describe it. -->

items.title: Month based override not working for opening_hours

### Description As [discussed in an OSM forum](https://community.openstreetmap.org/t/opening-hours-throughout-the-year-is-my-tagging-wrong-or-is-osmand/135567), OsmAnd seems to get the following opening_hours wrong: `07:00-17:00; Mar 07:00-19:00; Apr 07:00-21:00; May-Aug 07:00-22:00; Sep 07:00-21:00; Oct 07:00-19:00` Evaluating it on September 12th should result in [the OSM object (a park)](https://www.openstreetmap.org/way/118353598) closing at 21:00. However, OsmAnd says the object closes at 17:00, see attached screenshots. ### Steps to reproduce Visit geo:55.68509,12.57986 and select the "Kongens Have" text. ### Actual result When visiting at 14:09 on Sep 12th, OsmAnd says the park closes at 17:00. ### Expected result OsmAnd was expected to show the park closing at 21:00, because the "Sep" month indicator in the opening_hours tag is supposed to override the general 07:00-17:00 opening hour. ### Your Environment (required)
``` OsmAnd Version: 5.1.9. Android version: 15 Device model: Samsung Galaxy A53 5G ```

items.title: opening_hours:covid19=* display problem in OsmAnd
items.body:
For a few days OsmAnd display the "opening_hours:covid19=*" tag  
See the use  => https://taginfo.openstreetmap.org/keys/opening_hours%3Acovid19

It's great but **there are some problems in displaying certain values**.
I think it's important to improve such  things since the use of this tag unfortunately extends (nearly 50,000 uses)
See the tag page for reference => https://wiki.openstreetmap.org/wiki/Key:opening_hours:covid19


## **1/ opening_hours:covid19 "open" and "off" values**

**Tags :**
`opening_hours:covid19=off/closed `    => shop/service completely closed without any activity
`opening_hours:covid19=open`   => shop/service is open but the schedules are unknown

**In OsmAnd :**
For "off" or "closed" value the display is **"24/7 off"**
For "open" value the display  is **"Open 24/7"**

**Could it be just "Off" or "Open" without the "24/7" ?**

**Examples to see :**
Pharmacie Sainte-Thérèse => https://www.openstreetmap.org/node/3793962742
`opening_hours=Mo-Fr 08:45-13:00, 14:00-19:45; Sa 09:00-19:00`
`opening_hours:covid19=open`
![pharmacie ste therese open](https://user-images.githubusercontent.com/7645549/81925869-61d8cd80-95e1-11ea-9ab2-6fc7f8d9caed.png)

Thélem => https://www.openstreetmap.org/node/6635588489
`opening_hours=Tu-Fr 09:00-12:00,14:00-18:00; Sa 09:00-12:00`
`opening_hours:covid19=off`
![thelem off](https://user-images.githubusercontent.com/7645549/81925893-69987200-95e1-11ea-9bf7-c16b102c3322.png)


## **2/ opening_hours:covid19 "restricted" value**

**Tag :**
`opening_hours:covid19=restricted ` => Schedules approximately known or hard to describe

**In OsmAnd :**
It seems that this value is not supported. 

**Could it be supported ?**

##  **3/ opening_hours:covid19 "same" value**

**Tag :**
`opening_hours:covid19=same`  => the schedules are the same during the epidemic

**In OsmAnd :**
No "Covid19" shown.

**If "Covid" is not shown one don't know if the schedules are adapted or not.**

**Example to see :**
Royal Bikes => https://www.openstreetmap.org/node/5802243217
`opening_hours=Tu-Sa 9:00-19:00`
`opening_hours:covid19=same`
![royal bikes same](https://user-images.githubusercontent.com/7645549/81926532-62259880-95e2-11ea-8a07-ffa16cd35b81.png)


## **4/ opening_hours:covid19 "Free text"**

**Tagging and display in OsmAnd** :
If there's something like "schedule covid19 + free text" then we have both schedules but "Covid19" is not shown.

**It seems important to have this information.**

**Example to see :**
Optical Discount  => https://www.openstreetmap.org/node/4530499990
`opening_hours=Mo-Sa 10:00-19:00`
`opening_hours:covid19=Tu-Sa 10:30-13:00,14:30-17:30 "De préférence sur rendez-vous"`
![optical discount free texte](https://user-images.githubusercontent.com/7645549/81926565-710c4b00-95e2-11ea-8098-fd4db95d8fe0.png)

items.title: More intelligent display of opening hours during search
items.body:
Consider the following example: It is Saturday evening and I'm searching for a pharmacy:

![photo_2018-12-21_14-28-57](https://user-images.githubusercontent.com/1040784/50345068-fabf0280-052d-11e9-9173-5bcd902f3107.jpg)

Unfortunately all of the pharmacies around me are already closed. The displayed opening hours don't help me really much here because their time span is located in the past. Instead it would be more helpful to display the *next* opening of this facility. Either by replacing the currently displayed values or by displaying them in an additional row.

Sure I could tap on each pharmacy to see when they will open next by looking at the full opening hours. But this is tedious. I want to see when they will open _again_.
